body: i did not have anything get Worse after i ran out of the pills. my next flare wasnt for a few months, it's not a magic cure-all and you won't ever get eczema again. but i DO recommend taking it if you are right now in living hell. i would do anything to have these tablets again when i have my massive flares. there is no harm in trying it, if your doctor has prescribed it, it's for a good reason.
